# BVHTree Utilities (mathutils.bvhtree) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html\#module-mathutils.bvhtree "Link to this heading")

BVH tree structures for proximity searches and ray casts on geometry.

classmathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree "Link to this definition")classmethodFromBMesh( _bmesh_, _\*_, _epsilon=0.0_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.FromBMesh "Link to this definition")

BVH tree based on `BMesh` data.

Parameters:

- **bmesh** (`BMesh`) – BMesh data.

- **epsilon** ( _float_) – Increase the threshold for detecting overlap and raycast hits.


Returns:

BVHTree from BMesh data.

Return type:

[`BVHTree`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree "mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree")

classmethodFromObject( _object_, _depsgraph_, _\*_, _deform=True_, _cage=False_, _epsilon=0.0_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.FromObject "Link to this definition")

BVH tree based on `Object` data.

Parameters:

- **object** (`Object`) – Mesh object.

- **depsgraph** (`Depsgraph`) – Depsgraph to use for evaluating the mesh.

- **deform** ( _bool_) – Use mesh with deformations.

- **cage** ( _bool_) – Use modifiers cage.

- **epsilon** ( _float_) – Increase the threshold for detecting overlap and raycast hits.


Returns:

BVHTree from Object data.

Return type:

[`BVHTree`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree "mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree")

classmethodFromPolygons( _vertices_, _polygons_, _\*_, _all\_triangles=False_, _epsilon=0.0_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.FromPolygons "Link to this definition")

BVH tree constructed from geometry passed in as arguments.

Parameters:

- **vertices** ( _Sequence_ _\[_ _Sequence_ _\[_ _float_ _\]_ _\]_) – float triplets each representing `(x, y, z)` coordinates.

- **polygons** ( _Sequence_ _\[_ _Sequence_ _\[_ _int_ _\]_ _\]_) – Sequence of polygons, each containing indices to the vertices argument.

- **all\_triangles** ( _bool_) – Use when all **polygons** are triangles for more efficient conversion.

- **epsilon** ( _float_) – Increase the threshold for detecting overlap and raycast hits.


Returns:

BVHTree from polygon data.

Return type:

[`BVHTree`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree "mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree")

find\_nearest( _origin_, _distance=1.84467e+19_, _/_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.find_nearest "Link to this definition")

Find the nearest element (typically face index) to a point.

Parameters:

- **origin** (`Vector`) – Find nearest element to this point.

- **distance** ( _float_) – Maximum distance threshold.


Returns:

Returns a tuple: (position, normal, index, distance),
Values will all be None if no hit is found.

Return type:

tuple\[`Vector` \| None, `Vector` \| None, int \| None, float \| None\]

find\_nearest\_range( _origin_, _distance=1.84467e+19_, _/_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.find_nearest_range "Link to this definition")

Find the nearest elements (typically face index) to a point in the distance range.

Parameters:

- **origin** (`Vector`) – Find nearest elements to this point.

- **distance** ( _float_) – Maximum distance threshold.


Returns:

Returns a list of tuples (position, normal, index, distance)

Return type:

list\[tuple\[`Vector`, `Vector`, int, float\]\]

overlap( _other\_tree_, _/_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.overlap "Link to this definition")

Find overlapping indices between 2 trees.

Parameters:

**other\_tree** ( [`BVHTree`](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree "mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree")) – Other tree to perform overlap test on.

Returns:

Returns a list of unique index pairs, the first index referencing this tree, the second referencing the **other\_tree**.

Return type:

list\[tuple\[int, int\]\]

ray\_cast( _origin_, _direction_, _distance=sys.float\_info.max_, _/_) [¶](https://docs.blender.org/api/5.2/mathutils.bvhtree.html#mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.ray_cast "Link to this definition")

Cast a ray onto the geometry.

Parameters:

- **origin** (`Vector`) – Start location of the ray.

- **direction** (`Vector`) – Direction of the ray (normalized internally).

- **distance** ( _float_) – Maximum distance threshold.


Returns:

Returns a tuple: (position, normal, index, distance),
Values will all be None if no hit is found.

Return type:
